scholarships.name: Yoobee Creative and Tech Leaders Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Yoobee Creative and Tech Leaders Scholarship provides financial assistance to support learners entering creative programmes aligned to design, animation, game development, digital content, and creative technology pathways. LEARN MORE

scholarships.name: Yoobee Tech Futures Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Yoobee Tech Futures Scholarship provides financial assistance to support learners entering programmes aligned to technology, IT, cloud, cybersecurity, software development, and emerging digital capabilities. LEARN MORE

scholarships.name: Yoobee Equity Access Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Yoobee Equity Access Scholarship is designed to support learners from underrepresented backgrounds to access study at Yoobee College of Creative Innovation. This scholarship removes financial barriers and encourages diversity, inclusion, and innovation across technology and creative industries.

scholarships.name: Yoobee Master’s Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Yoobee Master’s Scholarship supports learners with the potential to become future industry leaders while improving access to postgraduate study for priority learners and contributing to advanced skills and innovation capability in Aotearoa New Zealand.
